name: vfx_fire_orb_pixel
source: Pinterest pin 573786808766258935 (GIF source, NOT video: 416x392, 15 frames, 60ms per frame, 16.67fps, 0.9s loop)
trim: all 15 source frames kept (0.9s at 16.67fps): fire beam -> fire ring -> energy sphere grows with orbiting black/white/yellow rings and glowing orbs inside -> sphere sustains -> cools to dark red orbs -> faint smoke wisp tail
method: background subtraction from a FLAT gray plate (measured corner color 108,107,107, std 0.43 across all frames, essentially uniform): alpha = clip((max-channel diff-16)/110) then Gaussian blur radius 3 on alpha only to melt GIF dither noise. Subtraction (not brightness threshold) was required so the BLACK orbiting rings survive: black vs gray gives diff ~108, same as bright fire vs gray
blending: normal with transparency; Additive also works for the fire glow
timing_note: keep 60ms per frame (16.67fps) in Godot; at 30fps it would play 1.8x too fast
